title: Quietly Dense Kenyan Olive Casserole
description: A buttery and dense Kenyan dish featuring castelvetrano olives, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a mother sauce base and shojin friendly ingredients. This casserole is a hearty and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the castelvetrano olives and cook for 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, mother sauce, kenyan spices, salt, and black pepper.
Add the flour mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Drizzle the vegetable oil over the top of the casserole.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the casserole is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
